definitions.explanation: Used to ask about a choice between two options. The polite form of どっち.
A polite way to ask where someone is from or where they are going.
A polite way to ask who someone is, often used in business contexts.

examples.english: Red or blue, which will you choose?

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧、どちら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、どちら⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose one from these two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧、どちら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れたくないん→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Which arrives faster, train or bus? I don't want to be late for work.

examples.japanese: どちら⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦いらっしゃいました→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
どちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{住|す}まい→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
どちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方面|ほうめん}→方面：12335_houmen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{出|で}かけ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。お⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{送|おく}りしましょう→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which direction are you heading? Shall I give you a ride?

examples.japanese: どちら⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who is it? / May I ask who's calling?

examples.japanese: ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、どちら⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, but may I ask who you are?

examples.japanese: どちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{勤|つと}め→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
どちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、どちら⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。お⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{聞|き}かせ→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry, but may I ask who you are? Could you tell me your name?

notes:
どちら is a polite interrogative with three main uses: asking which of two options, asking where (polite), and asking who (polite). It is more formal than ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧.

KO-SO-A-DO SERIES:
- ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧: this way/person (near speaker)
- ⟦そちら→そちら：00990_sochira⟧: that way/person (near listener)
- ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧: over there/that person
- どちら: which way/person (question)

KEY PATTERNS:
- どちら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Which do you prefer?
- どちら⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: Where are you going? (polite)
- どちら⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Who are you? (very polite)
- どちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{勤|つと}め→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Where do you work? (polite)

REGISTER:
どちら is the standard polite form. Use ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧ in casual speech. In business or formal situations, どちら is strongly preferred.
